title: Harness Enchantments
description: A datapack that adds armor enchantment equivalents to happy ghast harnesses!
body:
This Datapack adds 4 new enchantments to the game:
- Harness Protection
- Harness Fire Protection
- Harness Blast Protection
- Harness Projectile Protection

They have the same effects as the normal versions but scaled up to be 4 pieces of armor per level. Note that the harness itself doesn't add armor points to the happy ghast so the enchantments only reduce a percentage of damage.

**Due to a bug, the enchantment table doesn't put the enchantments onto the harnesses and you will instead need to enchant books and then combine onto an anvil to enchant the harness**.
All the specific damage type enchantments have double the effect of harness protection.
